observations.says: at nine o'clock on Thursday, Susan counted the strokes of the hall clock
from Thursday morning, the hall clock was right, set by the church clock
at a quarter to nine on Thursday by the stable clock, somebody fired a shot through the window of Sir Giles's study; on Friday morning, the stable clock was a quarter of an hour slow
at a quarter to nine on Thursday by the stable clock, Bowker looked at the stable clock
at ten minutes to nine on Thursday by the hall clock, Mr. Edwin Royle left the library
at nine o'clock on Thursday by the hall clock, somebody fired a shot through the window of Sir Giles's study
on Friday morning, the bullet was at Sir Giles's study
